description: This PHP script is an administrative endpoint for SuiteCRM, handling actions such as repairing and refreshing estimates related to XSS vulnerabilities in module data. It verifies user permissions, processes incoming requests, and interacts with module beans and database to perform actions.

methods.name: refreshEstimate
methods.description: Processes a request to refresh or estimate the number of records in modules, optionally targeting all modules or a specific one, and prepares a list of IDs for repair.

methods.name: repairXssExecute
methods.description: Executes repair actions on specified beans/records identified by their IDs, involving retrieving, modifying, and saving bean data.
